sentences.en: The millionaire lived in complete isolation from the outside world.
sentences.zh: 百万富翁与外界完全隔绝。

sentences.en: We shouldn't confuse solitude with isolation. They are two separate things.
sentences.zh: 我们不应将孤独与隔离混为一谈。它们是两回事。

sentences.en: The theme of isolation features prominently in his work.
sentences.zh: 孤立的主题在他的作品中占据了重要地位。

senses.zh: 隔离,隔离状态,孤独,孤立状态adj.孤立主义的,孤立主义者的
